project_type: PahadPulse — closed-loop hospitality guest-intelligence platform. Python FastAPI backend + Next.js 14 (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind) dashboard. Already built on branch main; this task is a follow-up: (1) a cohesive FRONTEND VISUAL/DESIGN-SYSTEM OVERHAUL (vibrant mountain palette + real typography pairing + more life/polish) and (2) a BACKEND RUN-PATH FIX so a fresh clone -> single documented command gives a populated, working dashboard.
build_system: Frontend: npm (Next.js 14). Backend: uv-managed venv (deps already synced). Root Makefile orchestrates setup/test/lint/build/demo; scripts/demo.sh runs uvicorn + next dev concurrently.
test_framework: Frontend: Vitest + React Testing Library (14 tests currently pass across 4 files). Backend: pytest (232 tests pass) + ruff.
build_command: Frontend: cd frontend && npm run build (currently builds 21 routes clean). Backend: cd backend && uv run python -c 'import app.main'.
test_command: Frontend: cd frontend && npm run lint && npx vitest run. Backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest.
verification_instructions: FRONTEND must stay green: `cd frontend && npm run lint && npx vitest run && npm run build`. BACKEND must stay green: `cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest`. The live dev server (uvicorn/next dev) is BLOCKED by a dev-server guard in this sandbox environment, so verify backend run-path/endpoints IN-PROCESS using fastapi.testclient.TestClient(app) inside a `uv run python - <<'PY' ... PY` heredoc. Example that already returns 200 with data: TestClient(app).get('/market-radar/review-counts'), '/sentinel/board', '/destination/heatmap', '/guest-compass/stays', '/market-radar/analytics/trends'. For the demo/seed path, exercise the seed step then TestClient, do NOT launch a live listener.
snapshot_or_generated_files: frontend/lib/*Snapshot.json are checked-in static fallback fixtures each dashboard page imports; pages render the snapshot first, then overwrite with live API data on mount and flip a 'Live from API' vs 'Sample snapshot' badge. Backend dataset artifacts under data/ (sample_reviews, datasheet, hinglish_test_set, benchmark, sentinel) are code-generated via backend/scripts/*.py and app.benchmark/validation modules. The SQLite DB file backend/data/pahadpulse.sqlite is gitignored.
setup_instructions: make setup (backend uv sync + frontend npm install). Deps already installed in this sandbox.
environment_constraints: Network OPEN_INTERNET: npm installs and Google Fonts via next/font/google are available at build time. Launching a live listener (uvicorn / next dev) is BLOCKED by a sandbox dev-server guard — do all backend run-path verification in-process with TestClient, and verify the frontend via build/lint/vitest only (no live browser). Node 22, Python 3.11.15 present.
contribution_requirements: Conventional-commit types (feat/chore/docs/fix/refactor). Keep all four quality gates green (FE lint+vitest+build, BE ruff+pytest). Do NOT push or open PRs. CONTRIBUTING.md exists.
key_patterns: THEME IS CENTRALISED IN THREE FILES THAT MUST STAY IN SYNC: frontend/tailwind.config.ts (color scales forest 50-950, mist, pine, dawn; fontFamily.sans=var(--font-sans); boxShadow ridge/tile; backgroundImage hill-haze/forest-header), frontend/app/globals.css (CSS vars mirroring palette, base layer using hill-haze bg + forest heading tones, .ridge-divider component), frontend/lib/theme.ts (palette object + brand/navItems; palette KEYS forest.DEFAULT/deep/mid/bright, mist.DEFAULT/white/haze, pine, dawn, ink are consumed by charts/LineChart.tsx + Sparkline.tsx). Shared UI primitives in components/ui (Badge, Button, Card, PageHeader, StatTile, Table), components/layout (AppShell, Header, Sidebar — Sidebar uses bg-forest-header), components/charts (LineChart, Sparkline palette-driven), components/common (Drilldown, MiniTrend). 18 route pages under frontend/app/(dashboard)/ inherit the look through tokens + primitives. layout.tsx currently does NOT wire next/font and --font-sans is never set (app falls back to system-ui) — this is the typography gap. Backend: every API endpoint reads from process-wide in-memory services (e.g. get_market_radar_service() @lru_cache seeds from app/seed/sample_reviews.build_review_records()); the SQLite DB is NOT required for endpoints to return data — they already return 200 with data in-process. main.py has NO lifespan/startup hook that creates DB schema or seeds. scripts/demo.sh runs `uv run uvicorn app.main:app` then `npm run dev` but performs NO seed/db-init step.
directory_structure: Repo root: README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, Makefile, scripts/demo.sh, .env.example, data/, backend/ (FastAPI), frontend/ (Next.js), .agents/tasks/. frontend: app/(dashboard)/<18 pages>, components/{ui,layout,charts,common,market-radar,destination}, lib/{api.ts,theme.ts,cn.ts,*Snapshot.json}. backend: app/{core,models,schemas,adapters,services/<subsystem>,api/routers,seed}, scripts/.
